assets.title: Low-Crown Pinnate Fern
assets.description: Original S02 hard-edge faceted fern with seven unequal arching fronds and a small grounded crown. Each continuous central rachis carries six pairs of separate folded lanceolate pinnae and a terminal leaflet; open pinna gaps form a feathered silhouette distinct from unsegmented grass blades. Five mature outward-bowing fronds and two shorter ascending inner fronds create a low asymmetric clump. Named editable closed-volume parts, solid PBR materials, metre scale and crown-centre ground origin Z=0. Independently authored static visual prop: no external textures, wind rig, animation, collision mesh, physics or species-accuracy guarantee.
